messages:
mira: heads-up — saw a big uptick in trace sampling churn during the eu-west GPU surge around 11:05. Prom alerts for high tail latency + lots of orphan runtime spans. anyone else?
devon: saw it too, alerts started spiking at ~11:06. grafana shows a tight correlation with 'gpu.request.latency_p99' and 'otel.span_export_failures'.
jonah: logs from the otel-gateway show repeated 'traceparent missing' on some proxy paths, but only for ~15% of requests. those requests also had fallback model routing.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2027-1145 — otel sampling + gateway propagation during eu-west burst.
tina: quick theory: we have two problems colliding — sampling decisions are made downstream (SDK) and gateways are rebalancing requests (fanout) so spans get split/lost, plus exporter backpressure causes SDK to drop batches.
alex: +1. if exporter queue fills it drops spans. we're seeing batch_timeout shrink under load; SDK tries to flush and hits the gateway rate limiter which then re-routes.
mira: can we get the exact otel SDK config from the affected services? looking for BatchSpanProcessor settings, exporter queue size, and sampler.
devon: pulling one from a model-worker:
```
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_always_on
OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY_MILLIS=500
OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE=2048
OTEL_BSP_MAX_EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE=512
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf
```
jonah: that schedule delay is too small for the burst pattern — we should increase schedule_delay to 2000 and reduce max_batch_size to 128 to avoid big spikes and long export cycles. also queue size 2048 means memory + long export times.
tina: aside from SDK tuning, gateway is doing per-request fanout to 4 runtime pods; when one path loses traceparent header due to proxy rewrite we end up with span fragments. we should ensure traceparent is forwarded verbatim by the nginx/envoy layer.
alex: confirm — envoy config had `preserve_external_trace_context: false` in a few clusters (bad default we rolled accidentally). changing to true will stop reparenting.
mira: good catch. action plan proposal: 1) change envoy preserve flag in eu-west proxy, 2) bump BSP delay to 2000ms + max_batch_size 128 for model-worker, 3) add deterministic sticky routing by traceid modulo N at the otel-gateway to reduce fanout for active traces, 4) temp relax Prom alert thresholds for span_export_failures while we rollout. thoughts?
devon: sticky routing by traceid sounds promising — keeps KV cache hits and prevents spans being split across pods. but must be careful: it reduces load distribution and could overload a single pod during hot traces. maybe a hybrid: sticky for traces over X concurrent requests.
jonah: implementation note: compute shard = trace_id_low64 % pool_size, route to that shard. simple, deterministic. we should add a circuit-breaker so if shard is at capacity we fall back to round-robin.
tina: for immediate mitigation I'll open a PR to set preserve_external_trace_context=true and post a canary to eu-west. also will patch the otel-gateway to emit a span_stitching metric so we can track how many spans lose parent.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: deploy/patch-envoy-eu-west (author: tina) — status queued.
mira: for alerts — please change the alert expression to have a 5m window and higher threshold while we deploy, but keep paging on p99 latency breaches. we don't want ops fatigue for every small exporter blip.
alex: I'll update the dashboard with a new panel 'trace_stitch_rate' and add an annotation when the envoy change goes out.
devon: followups: 1) post-mortem checklist entry to ensure SDK default BSP settings are reviewed for all model-worker images; 2) test deterministic sticky routing at scale in staging; 3) consider backpressure feedback from otel-gateway -> SDK (throttle signals).
mira: thanks — if everyone can ack their tasks here I'll coordinate the rollout.
jonah: acked (implement sticky + metric).
tina: acked (envoy flag + canary).
alex: acked (dash + alert tweak).
devon: acked (SDK config PR + staging test).
mira: wrapping — I'll monitor spans and update INC-2027-1145. :pray:
ops-bot: incident INC-2027-1145 status changed to: monitoring
